system.description: The Path of the Just teaches you that every life deserves a fair chance. With your abilities, you can protect those that need protection and feed those that need food, making sure everyone has a fighting chance to enjoy al-Musawwir’s creation. Spend 3 Hope and choose an ally within Close range. They are marked with a glowing sigil of protection. When this ally would next take damage, they may ignore it. You may only affect someone in this way once per Rest.
system.usageNote: Once per target per Rest. Track affected targets in Notes.
